title: Kivilo
shortDescription: Capture, review and sign property condition reports on site.
fullDescription:
Kivilo helps Singapore property agents complete check-in and check-out condition reports on site. Create an inspection, walk the property room by room, record a narrated video, and photograph serial plates, meter readings, and damage. Captures are saved on the phone first and upload when a connection is available.

With your permission, AI drafts a room inventory from the evidence. You review and edit each room before sending the report for the landlord and tenant to sign. Share a private report link and revoke it when needed.

At check-out, repeat the walkthrough and review a comparison against the signed check-in. Damage and fair-wear findings stay private until you publish a separate, dated assessment. The signed inventory remains unchanged.
